title: The Street That Fell Asleep
text: At noon a whole street fell asleep, and it has not woken. The sleepers' breath frosts in the summer air. Under their lids, all their eyes move together in the same direction.

options.label: Send a Scion into the dream after them to lead the sleepers home.

outcomes.text: The Scion walks out of the dream with the sleepers behind them, steadier than when they went.
The sleepers wake, but the Scion does not for three days, and is not the same when they do.

options.label: Wall up the street before whatever they dream of comes looking.

outcomes.text: Within a month the breathing behind the wall stops. The masons do not come back to work.

options.label: Wait and watch the sleepers to learn where their eyes are looking.

outcomes.text: On the ninth day they wake starving, all facing the same way, unable to say where they were.
On the ninth day the street is empty. The beds are still warm.
